_note: GENERATED by tools/provenance/build-graph.mjs. Do not hand-edit — a hand-written provenance file is exactly the kind of artifact that outlives its truth (A9).

_chains.observation: metric → payload field → KV key → fetcher → external source
_chains.parameter: published figure → engine constant → register row → cited source
_chains._disjoint: These two chains share NO join key. metricRegistry.workerPath names a field on an observed payload; register.engine_binding names a model parameter. Measured: 0 of 9 workerPaths match any of 68 engine_bindings. They are disjoint, not incompatible, and fusing them by a hand-written key map would be a fiction — an RTE constant is not upstream of an installed-MW observation.

staleness_inheritance._gap: No register row references a dataset, so no parameter can inherit the evidence base's freshness. Fixing it is one field on the register row (`dataset: 'da'`), not new machinery — and until then a parameter sourced from a series last refreshed months ago is indistinguishable from one sourced yesterday.
